subject: Woven - data curation
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Woven-by-Toyota, Wayve, and Oxa - so thought it could be interesting to explore if we can help at [COMPANY] in a similar way.

The common challenges these teams faced were with existing data curation & visualisation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools) lacking the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their large training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing / searching through datasets (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling AV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Woven, Wayve, Oxa and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us connecting?

subject: [COMPANY] & Encord - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

I was listening to your presentation on Safety View at the Vision Zero
Network panel. Thought I'd reach out since we work with AGD Systems &
Automotous on developing very similar predictive ML models for
transpoemgmt, with the goals to speed up new product releases in traffic
and safety.

We assist with improving model quality / delivery speed while keeping
development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data mgmt and
by allowing them to curate/annotate data from connected vehicles at scale
on our platform. (Similarly, we've just onboarded Woven by Toyota to help
manage their data pipelines.)

Bit of context on Encord: we're a data development platform built for
advanced computer vision and multimodal AI teams to build better models (~5
years old, 90+ employees & raised $50M+ funding).

I've been following [COMPANY] for a while now. Would love to get your candid
feedback on what we're building here at Encord if you have 30mins to chat.
Open to a quick call this week or the next? Wednesdays / Thursdays work
